data.name: Kelby
data.gender_notes: Kelby is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English ‘celif’, meaning ‘narrow’, ‘slender’ or ‘bright’. Kelby may have also been a topographic name for someone who lived near a narrow or winding river or valley. The name Kelby carries the meaning “Slender, narrow” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Kelby usually hope their child will grow to embody slender, narrow and live with faith, good character and purpose.

Historically, the name Kelby has been used in England and has been adopted in various Christian cultures. It symbolizes a connection to nature and may signify spiritual growth or renewal.
